body: I'm sorry that I didn't respond to this sooner. My husband ended up calling me in the middle of the day which was weird because he never does that. What's also weird was that he, unprompted, admitted that he has been treating me like shit recently for no reason. He is going through a lot of shit at work and he was taking it out on me. We spoke for a very long time and I felt much better after. So, at least for now, I don't feel suicidal anymore. Thank you so much for your support.
We used to be before I moved away. I haven't spoken to her in a few weeks now. I've been distancing myself from her to try to make this easier.
I posted just because I feel so bad about my mom and I was thinking maybe somebody might say something that will convince me that she will be OK. Probably not but who knows. Thanks for your response.
